diagram:
{ "type":"diagram", "diagramType":"cycle|pyramid|staircase|snake|arrow-seq|circular-grid|connected-circles", "nodes":[{"title":"...","sub":"...(可选)"}] }
2-8 个节点。cycle=首尾相接阶段；pyramid=层级/包含；staircase=递进；snake=6+步换行线性序列；arrow-seq=醒目的2-5步线性链；circular-grid=围绕中心的并列项；connected-circles=无具名边的概念关联。只在形状语义本身成立时使用。
graph:
{ "type":"graph", "graphType":"tree|dag|flowchart", "orientation":"vertical|horizontal(可选)", "nodes":[{"id":"a","title":"...","sub":"...(可选)","state":"on|q(可选)","shape":"box|round|diamond(可选)"}], "edges":[{"from":"a","to":"b","label":"...(可选)","style":"solid|dashed(可选)"}], "caption":"...(可选)" }
2-14 个节点、1-24 条真实具名边。tree=单根且每节点至多一个父；dag=允许多父/汇聚但无环；flowchart=判定分支，diamond 节点配是/否边，回边必须 dashed。所有边引用已有 id，禁止孤立节点。
